app.name: Uber - Request a Ride
app.description: Request a ride, order food delivery, and get where you need to go.

verdict.one_liner: A ride and delivery app that collects vast amounts of personal data and shares it widely with advertisers and partners.
verdict.summary: Uber provides convenient transportation and delivery, but its privacy practices are extensive. It tracks your precise location, collects government ID and facial verification data, and shares information with a broad network of advertising partners and data resellers. While you have some privacy controls, the sheer volume of data collection and sharing is significant.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Uber collects and shares an unusually large amount of sensitive data, including your location, identity documents, and trip details, with advertisers and data brokers. Use the privacy settings to limit ad personalization and location sharing if you choose to use the app.

red.title: Precise location tracked and approximate location shared with advertisers
red.plain_english: Uber collects your precise location during trips and when the app is open. It shares your approximate location and trip details with ad intermediaries such as Google and The Trade Desk to personalize ads.

red.title: Government ID and facial scans collected
red.plain_english: For verification and age-restricted items, Uber may require photos of your government ID and real-time selfies. This biometric data is stored for up to three years.

red.title: Data shared with ad networks and resellers
red.plain_english: Uber receives demographic and interest data from data resellers and shares your information with advertising companies, ad intermediaries, and social media platforms to target ads.

red.title: Calls with drivers and support may be recorded
red.plain_english: When you communicate with drivers through the app or contact customer support, your calls and messages may be recorded and stored.

red.title: Some data kept for up to 7 years
red.plain_english: Even after you delete your account, Uber retains location data, trip history, and communications for up to 7 years for legal and insurance purposes.

green.title: Ad personalization can be disabled
green.plain_english: Uber lets you turn off personalized ads and marketing communications in the Privacy Center settings.

green.title: Account deletion available
green.plain_english: You can request account deletion through the Privacy Center, and most data is deleted within 90 days.

green.title: Download your data feature
green.plain_english: Uber provides a tool to download copies of your account, usage, communications, and device data.

green.title: Precise location is optional
green.plain_english: You can use Uber without sharing precise location, though you'll need to manually enter addresses.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Uber collects photos, audio recordings, and videos you upload for customer support or identity verification. In-app audio may be recorded, and real-time selfies are required for some verifications.
categories.detail: User content includes uploaded photos and recordings, in-app audio recordings, and user-generated content like restaurant reviews. Identity verification requires real-time selfies. In-vehicle recordings may be collected in autonomous vehicles.
categories.policy_excerpt: User content: Uploaded photos and audio or video recordings, including in-app audio recordings, and user generated content. Identity verification: User-submitted selfies, facial verification information.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Uber collects precise location from request through trip completion when the app is open. Approximate location is determined continuously. Location data is shared with ad partners.
categories.detail: Precise location is collected from the time you request a ride or order until completion when the app is open. Approximate location is always collected. Location is shared with drivers and used for ad personalization.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you request a ride, we track your driver's location during your trip... We also determine your approximate location and can determine your precise location if you allow us... We will collect your precise location from the time you request a ride or order until the ride is finished.
concerns: Precise location tracked during entire trip

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Uber may access contacts for referral programs or features like fare splitting, but this is optional and not required for basic ride booking.
categories.detail: Contacts may be accessed for referral programs (when someone refers you to Uber) and for features like fare splitting or sharing ETAs with friends.
categories.policy_excerpt: Users participating in Uber's referral programs. For example, if you are referred to Uber by another user, we receive your data from that user.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload photos for customer support or identity verification. This is optional and only happens when you choose to upload.
categories.detail: File access is used for uploading photos for customer support issues, identity verification documents, and proof of delivery photos.
categories.policy_excerpt: Upload photos and recordings (including those submitted for purposes of customer support).

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Uber shares your data extensively with advertising partners, data resellers, social media companies, and service providers. Some sharing is for ads you can't fully opt out of.
categories.detail: Data is shared with ad and marketing partners, ad intermediaries (Criteo, Google, Rokt, The Trade Desk), data resellers, social media companies (Meta, TikTok), and various service providers. Some ad personalization can be opted out.
categories.policy_excerpt: Ad and marketing partners... ad intermediaries such as Criteo, Google, Rokt, The Trade Desk, TripleLift... Marketing partners, advertisers, and service providers... data resellers.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Uber collects extensive identity data including government IDs and facial scans for verification. This data may be stored for years and is linked to your advertising profile.
categories.detail: Account information includes name, email, phone, payment method, profile photo. Identity verification requires government IDs and real-time selfies/biometric facial verification. Demographics including inferred gender are collected.
categories.policy_excerpt: Government-issued identification documents... User-submitted selfies... Facial verification information... Demographic data... inferred gender (using first name).

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Uber tracks your trips, orders, and app usage to build an advertising profile. It shares this data with ad networks and receives additional data about your interests from data brokers.
categories.detail: Uber uses trip/order history, search history, app usage, and demographics to personalize ads. Receives enrichment data from data resellers including demographics, interests, lifestyle, purchasing behavior, and viewing preferences.
categories.policy_excerpt: Use your personal data to understand your interests, preferences, or characteristics... Enrichment data such as demographics (age range, household income range, gender), general interests and lifestyle, general purchasing behavior, viewing preferences and streaming habits.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Uber is not intended for users under 18. The app requires users to be adults, and there are specific teen account options managed by parents.
categories.detail: Uber requires users to be 18+. Uber for teens is a separate product with parental oversight. Age verification is required for age-restricted products.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect your date of birth and/or age to verify your eligibility to use age-restricted products or services, such as Uber for teens.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Uber logs your IP address and network data for security and fraud prevention. This is standard practice for most apps.
categories.detail: Device IP address is collected along with network data. Used for security, fraud prevention, and service delivery.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device IP address or other unique device identifiers... Mobile network data.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Uber collects advertising identifiers and detailed device information. This data is used for ad targeting and shared with advertising partners.
categories.detail: Collects advertising identifiers, device motion data, IP address, hardware models, OS versions, and preferred languages. Used for personalization, ads, and fraud detection.
categories.policy_excerpt: Advertising identifiers... Device motion data... Device IP address or other unique device identifiers... Hardware models... Operating systems and versions.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Uber collects facial verification data (biometrics) when verifying your identity. Selfies are stored for up to 3 years and compared against your ID photo.
categories.detail: Facial verification technology is used to confirm identity, age, and prevent fraudulent accounts. User-submitted selfies are compared to ID photos using biometric analysis. Stored for 3 years.
categories.policy_excerpt: Biometric data is generated when we use facial verification technology to confirm that your account is not being used by anyone other than you... 3 years for user-submitted selfies.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Uber collects payment method information and trip/order payment details. Payments are processed through third-party processors.
categories.detail: Payment method information including related verification info is collected. Payment processors include PayPal and Hyperwallet. Transaction history is retained for 7 years.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment method (including related payment verification information)... Payment processors and facilitators, including PayPal and Hyperwallet.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account through the Privacy Center, and most data is deleted within 90 days. However, some data is kept for up to 7 years for legal reasons.
categories.detail: Account deletion available via Privacy Center. Data generally deleted within 90 days of request. Exceptions for safety, security, fraud prevention, and legal compliance. Some data retained up to 7 years.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may request that we delete your account through Privacy menus... We generally delete data within 90 days of an account deletion request... retain your data for 7 years from collection if necessary for purposes of Uber's tax, insurance, legal or regulatory requirements.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Uber will notify you in advance of significant policy changes through the app or email. Continued use after changes constitutes consent.
categories.detail: Significant changes are notified in advance through apps or email. Users are encouraged to periodically review the notice. Continued use constitutes consent to updated notice.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make significant changes, we will notify you in advance of the changes through the Uber apps or through other means, such as email... Use of our services after an update constitutes consent.
concerns: No specific advance notice period defined
